pack.title: Blame shifting
pack.description: Correct a public accusation with evidence.

scenarios.setting: A teammate attributes a missed deadline to you although you sent your part on time.
scenarios.jab: We're late because your team didn't deliver.
scenarios.goal: Correct a public accusation with evidence.

replies.line: Our part went out Tuesday. Let's check where the handoff stalled.
replies.why: A dated fact replaces blame with a traceable handoff.
replies.delivery: Emphasize “Tuesday,” avoid stressing “your,” and pause for the record to be checked.

replies.line: Sent Tuesday. Let's check the handoff.
replies.why: It gives the relevant fact without adding a counteraccusation.
replies.delivery: Emphasize “Tuesday,” avoid stressing “your,” and pause for the record to be checked.

replies.line: I have the Tuesday handoff here; let's find what got missed together.
replies.why: Offering the record and a joint next step keeps the correction collaborative.
replies.delivery: Emphasize “Tuesday,” avoid stressing “your,” and pause for the record to be checked.

replies.line: Let's let the timestamps do the talking.
replies.why: A small joke redirects attention from personalities to the record.
replies.delivery: Keep “Let's let the timestamps do the talking” light; let the joke stand without repeating it. ” and pause for the record to be checked.

followUp.jab: That's not how I remember it.
followUp.line: Let's open the thread and check the dates before assigning responsibility.
followUp.why: It asks both sides to verify the record before reaching a conclusion.
followUp.delivery: Pause before “Let's open the thread and check the dates before assigning,” keep the volume even, then allow an answer without reopening your decision.
